evidence: Workbook row 12 / quality-checks.md:54 / staged-task-contract.md:78 require that [environment].docker_image is not set while the agent Dockerfile has active build steps. Frozen task/task.toml lines 20-24 [environment] contain only build_timeout_sec = 600.0, network_mode = "public", cpus = 2, memory_mb = 4096; parsing with tomllib gives environment keys ['build_timeout_sec','cpus','memory_mb','network_mode'] and a recursive walk finds no key containing 'image' anywhere in task.toml ([verifier.environment] holds only network_mode = "public"). The agent Dockerfile task/environment/Dockerfile has active build steps (FROM node:22-bookworm-slim, apt-get install line 5, npm install -g express@5.1.0 better-sqlite3@12.4.1 line 9, COPY instructions/ and assets/ lines 14-15, git init of /app lines 16-23), so it is the image actually built and it is not shadowed. task/environment/ contains only Dockerfile, assets/, instructions/ (no docker-compose file that could substitute an image). Template comparison: frozen template task.toml [environment] is byte-identical in this section (template also has no docker_image); task Dockerfile sha256 0a75419e...67d1 equals the template environment/Dockerfile sha256, and the live projects/ task.toml (ac664d0e...8f26) and Dockerfile match the frozen snapshot bytes. Adversarial consideration: a broken variant would add docker_image = "some/prebuilt:tag" so harbor skips the Dockerfile and /assets,/instructions or pinned express/better-sqlite3 silently differ; that is absent here. A conforming alternative (docker_image set with Dockerfile reduced to no build steps) is not relevant since no image is set. This is a static configuration row; no runtime measurement is required to decide it, and no Docker build was run in this review.
